This is a low-severity, low-risk cross-tenant data exposure vuln caused by blindly accepting a durable task id, in addition to a list of node and branch ids that identify records in that task's event log, and returning them to the caller via the `handleWorkerStatus` polling path.

# Impact

This advisory requires an attacker to successfully guess a durable task's external uuid belonging to another tenant. External ids are generated uuid v4s (`uuid.New()` in Go), so exploitation requires prior knowledge of a target task UUID through an out-of-band channel. Thus, while the following environments are impacted, there is an extremely low probability it would be exploited.

### Who is impacted. Any Hatchet deployment that hosts more than one tenant on the same instance:

* Hatchet Cloud (multi-tenant SaaS)
* Self-hosted Hatchet with multiple internal teams / business units sharing one instance
* Any deployment where a single tenant's API token can be obtained by an attacker

Single-tenant self-hosted deployments are unaffected in practice (the "victim" and "attacker" tenants would be the same).", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00168, "percentile": 0.06529}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-22T20:40:46Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-88978"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-21T16:17:26Z", "published_at": "2026-09-22T20:40:46Z", "references": ["https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet/security/advisories/GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-88978", "https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet/commit/15bc7923d3a8ebfeb0d88c19160dd24828921e85", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/hatchet-dev/hatchet/security-advisories/GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet", "summary": "Hatchet DurableTask WorkerStatus gRPC resolves caller-supplied durable-task UUIDs via ListSatisfiedEntries with no tenant_id filter", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-22T20:40:48Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-992g-9cr3-vm5x", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "0.106.1", "package": {"ecosystem": "go", "name": "github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 0.106.1"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
